words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) is the governed subject of the emphatic clause: the Lord is fixed before the watchpost predicate is disclosed. Its accusative case distinguishes this from the acting {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) of 89:13, so the same Lord moves from performed punishment into a permanent certainty claim. The attached {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) keeps the declaration personal; the watcher is the hearer's own Lord, not an abstract power, and the singular possessed form makes a very common root distinctive through address, case, and position. The title also matters lexically: the {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) field joins ownership, authority, nurture, and ordering care, so scrutiny at {{ar:ٱلْمِرْصَادِ}} ({{tr:al-mirṣād}}) belongs to moral lordship rather than impersonal surveillance. The staying or settling pressure in the wider root field makes that lordship feel continuously stationed, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as the Lord-title. Against the worlds-wide lordship formula of 1:2, 89:14 narrows the title into watch over historical power after 89:6-13 and carries it forward into the human test of favor in 89:15-16. Across the surah, this word links the actor of 89:13 with the watched station of 89:14, the open coming of the Lord in 89:22, and the return to the Lord in 89:28. The movement from the nasal emphasis of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) into the doubled consonant of {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) makes the named subject feel audibly weighted.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمِرْصَادِ}} ({{tr:al-mirṣād}}) is the word where the delayed predicate lands. It is definite and genitive after {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), so it completes the predicate as a specific station rather than acting as a vague place, independent subject, or object. Lexically, it does more than say that the Lord knows: the {{ar:ر ص د}} ({{tr:r-ṣ-d}}) field selects a watchpost, lookout, or ambush-station where conduct passes under prepared observation and possible interception. Its pattern lets the noun work as both place and apparatus, and the broader tracking, guarding, waiting, and preparation derivatives sharpen that station as already set before wrongdoing arrives. The root's other first-rain branch is not the local sense. Concrete echoes intensify the field: guarded access (72:9; 72:27) becomes guarded history here, Jahannam as a watchpost (78:21) contrasts with the Lord at the watchpost in 89:14, and watched-route control (9:5) adds the sense of movement that can be stopped without controlling the local parse. Structurally, the final noun freezes the motion after 89:13 into a standing station and turns the specific punishment into a general rule; it also lets the Lord-title and watchpost image answer each other before the human misreading of divine treatment in 89:15. Its closing sound and final position make the accountability image land hard, as the quick {{ar:لَبِ}} ({{tr:la-bi}}) entry expands into the heavier place-image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive Lord noun at word 2 governs the locative watch-post noun at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ownership and authority are spatialized as a watcher stationed on a traversed path: governance is continuous observation backed by the capacity to intercept.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the watcher with jurisdiction over whatever passes.
Watching, guarding, and lying in wait supply active vigilance with an interceptive edge.
A lookout place or watched path locates the vigilance at a passage rather than in detached observation.

changed_reading.before: The line merely assures that the Lord sees wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The line places sovereign attention on the route itself, where seeing can become interception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Lord noun at word 2 and the watch-post noun at word 3 combine care, duration, and advance preparation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The administrator who nurtures things stage by stage maintains a standing reserve of fitting outcomes; the station is patient completion rather than impulsive reaction.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, administration, and completion make lordship a process that brings trajectories to maturity.
Staying, clinging, and lasting contribute the continuity needed for a standing station.
Preparing or setting something aside for a debt or recompense supplies the reserved outcome.

changed_reading.before: The watch-post is an immediate threat waiting to spring.
changed_reading.after: The watch-post is also long-duration governance in which consequences are already provisioned while conduct develops.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can carry a protection pact while word 3 names a prepared station on a path.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship binds protection and obligation; the path-station becomes a checkpoint where liabilities are answered and protected passage can be granted.

activation_trace.role: A covenant or protection pact supplies a binding relation rather than bare domination.
An item prepared for debt or recompense makes the checkpoint answer outstanding liability.
The path-side lookout supplies the crossing at which covenantal status becomes consequential.

changed_reading.before: The station only threatens an enemy.
changed_reading.after: The station enforces a relation: it can expose breach, settle liability, or secure protected passage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant mapping for word 2 supplies raised ground, while word 3 supplies a lookout place.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant elevation image composes with the locative noun as a high vantage from which routes below are visible.

activation_trace.role: Raised ground supplies literal elevation and a possible vantage point, while remaining a non-dominant mapped activation.
The lookout post or watched path turns elevation into route surveillance.

changed_reading.before: Lordship is only a relational title.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the title also casts a topographic image of an elevated lookout over every route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternates darkness, nocturnal motion, and dawn rupture, turning the watch-post from a fixed point into the temporal threshold where concealed movement becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and guarding supply attention sustained through a period of concealment.
The lookout place supplies the threshold at which a moving subject can be detected.
Dawn breaking out of night supplies the disclosure event at the end of hidden motion.
Night and its darkness supply the interval in which routes and conduct remain concealed.
Night travel supplies motion through concealment, making the station monitor a passage over time.

structural_cues: The oath sequence begins with dawn and later depicts night itself in transit before the focus assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies darkness, night travel, dawn rupture, and a lookout; I infer the arrow hidden transit to disclosure. A live alternative is that the opening images remain oath objects and do not temporalize the station.

changed_reading.before: The Lord occupies a permanently fixed observation point.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's station is also the moment of emergence when what traveled unseen can no longer remain hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Completion, paired and unpaired cases, division into shares, and restraining reason make the prepared station an exhaustive sorter: joined cases and remainders alike receive a fitting allotment.

activation_trace.role: Preparation for debt or recompense supplies outcomes ready to be allotted.
Completing nine with a tenth supplies closure rather than an open-ended count.
Joining a thing to its like supplies the paired class.
A single item without a pair supplies the unmatched remainder that must still be counted.
Separating a thing into shares supplies the station's allocative operation.
Reason as a restraining barrier supplies discrimination and a limiting rule for the sorting.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a completed number through paired and odd categories to an oath addressed to restraining intelligence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, pairing, singular remainder, division, and rational restraint; I infer the arrow classification to fitting recompense. The live alternative is that these are parallel oath images without an accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A prepared recompense is generic and undifferentiated.
changed_reading.after: The station sorts every case, including the unmatched remainder, into a bounded and fitting share.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing is followed by attributed action and then by a poured instrument of punishment; the station therefore joins observation to prepared intervention rather than stopping at awareness.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign authority supplies the competence to convert observation into judgment.
Lying in wait for a leap supplies the transition from vigilance to intervention.
A recompense set aside in advance supplies readiness before the intervention occurs.
Showing or making visible frames the historical action as inspectable evidence.
The production of an act supplies actual execution rather than a merely contemplated response.
The repeated Lord title assigns the ensuing action to the same governing authority as the focus line.
Pouring supplies the release of what had been held ready.
The whip and its stroke supply an instrument that reaches its target.
Painful punishment supplies the judicial result of the released intervention.

structural_cues: The focus line immediately follows the clause in which the same Lord pours punishment on the transgressing peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visibility, action, waiting, preparation, pouring, striking, and punishment; I infer the arrow observation to timed execution. The live alternative is that the punishment is only a prior example and does not define the station's operation.

changed_reading.before: The station testifies that nothing escapes notice.
changed_reading.after: The station is operational: notice matures into a prepared and targeted intervention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pillars, penetrated rock, flood paths, and fixed stakes describe powers that engineer durable control of land; overflow beyond limits and systemic corruption make the Lord's path-station a counter-infrastructure across their routes.

activation_trace.role: A watched road or prepared trapping place supplies a network interception point.
Columns and supports supply the built system's vertical durability.
Penetrating cutting supplies the power to force routes through resistant matter.
Great hard rock supplies the resistant medium mastered by the engineered system.
A valley as a flood channel supplies a natural route that can carry force through the land.
Stake-like fixity supplies the regime's claim to stable emplacement.
Overtopping water and sweeping force turn transgression into boundary-breaking overflow.
Departure from sound order supplies the system-wide damage produced by that overflow.

structural_cues: Three powers are remembered through monumental or territorial features, then jointly characterized by transgression and multiplied corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable structures, cut routes, a flood channel, fixity, overflow, corruption, and a watched path; I infer the arrow imperial infrastructure to counter-interception. A live alternative is that the material details display grandeur without mapping a route system.

changed_reading.after: The station spans the channels and durable systems through which organized power expands, so engineered strength creates no unwatched exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Multiplied disorder is accumulated into a mixed scourge and then poured; the prepared station behaves like a reservoir that converts dispersed violations into a composite consequence.

activation_trace.role: Setting recompense aside supplies storage before release.
Increase and numerical growth supply accumulation over many acts.
Departure from soundness supplies the damaging material that accumulates.
Pouring supplies a concentrated discharge from the prepared reserve.
Mixing one thing with another supplies the composite character of the scourge.
Painful punishment fixes the mixture's punitive outcome.

structural_cues: The text first says corruption was increased, then depicts punishment through a liquid verb and a noun whose inventory also carries mixing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, corruption, preparation, mixing, pouring, and punishment; I infer the arrow accumulation to composite discharge. The live alternative is that the scourge noun only means a whip, leaving no reservoir mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Each offense meets a separate ambush.
changed_reading.after: The station can accumulate dispersed corruption and release a compounded response when its measure is full.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expansion and constriction are tests that expose the beliefs voiced about the Lord; the station monitors not only deeds but the interpretive conversion of provision into claims of personal worth.

activation_trace.role: Stage-by-stage administration supplies providential changes that can form and disclose the subject.
Watching supplies attention to the human response elicited by changing conditions.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the diagnostic operation.
The repeated revealing test makes constriction a second probe rather than a simple verdict.
Honor and admired generosity supply the positive condition that the subject mistakes for settled rank.
Good condition and bounty supply experiential ease within the first probe.
Speech as belief or doctrine turns the utterance into evidence of the subject's governing interpretation.
The mirrored belief-speech supplies the contrary but equally mistaken interpretation.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the negative condition of the second probe.
An apportioned gift makes provision a measured input rather than proof of intrinsic worth.
Humiliation through being treated lightly supplies the subject's mistaken reading of limited provision.

structural_cues: The two mirrored clauses explicitly call both abundance and constriction a test, then repeat first-person claims about the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two revealing tests, measured provision, contrary conditions, and belief-like speech; I infer the arrow providential variation to exposed interpretation. The live alternative is that the later clauses only correct economic theology without specifying what the station watches.

changed_reading.before: The station records overt transgression after it occurs.
changed_reading.after: The station is also diagnostic governance: changing provision reveals the hidden equation people make between wealth and worth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unguarded child, food owed outward, and inheritance moving inward are custody transfers; the Lord's station stands at social choke points where resources should cross toward the vulnerable but can instead be consumed and consolidated.

activation_trace.role: The caregiver or foster relation supplies a concrete custodial dimension of lordship.
A watched path supplies the transfer point at which possession changes hands.
A child cut off from a guardian supplies the exposed claimant whose custody has failed.
Feeding another supplies the required outward movement of sustenance.
Provision that makes settled residence possible identifies what the vulnerable recipient lacks.
Consuming and taking wealth supplies the wrongful inward diversion.
Property passing from predecessor to heir supplies the legally and socially charged transfer.
Gathering scattered things into one mass supplies consolidation that blocks fair distribution.

structural_cues: After rejecting wealth as a measure of honor, the text names failures toward the orphan and needy and then the indiscriminate consumption of inheritance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed guardianship, outward feeding, sustaining provision, inheritance transfer, consumption, consolidation, and a watched path; I infer the arrow transfer interface to moral checkpoint. The live alternative is that these are separate offenses rather than one custody mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The station is remote from ordinary economic exchange.
changed_reading.after: The station is present at each custody transfer, especially where an unprotected claim can be diverted into a stronger party's store.

context_deltas.mechanism: Leveling removes terrain and concealment, arrivals assemble in ordered rows, and memory returns; the hidden path-station unfolds into a manifest court where watcher, subject, and consequence are simultaneously present.

activation_trace.role: The concealed lookout or trapping place supplies the initially hidden judicial position.
Pounding and demolition until level supply the removal of sheltering topography.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the entire exposed field.
Coming and becoming present supply the manifestation of the governing party.
Bringing and presenting a thing supply the arrival of the consequence before the subject.
The angelic branch supplies the assembled agents in the scene.
Alignment on a straight line supplies visible order and removes unclassified gaps.
Recovering what was forgotten supplies inward disclosure at the same moment as outward manifestation.

structural_cues: The scene progresses from repeated leveling to arrival, row after row, presentation of punishment, and belated recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hidden post, total leveling, paired arrivals, rows, and recovered memory; I infer the arrow concealed surveillance to public adjudication. The live alternative is that the later court succeeds the station without being its manifested form.

changed_reading.before: The station remains hidden while subjects continue along ordinary terrain.
changed_reading.after: The station eventually becomes an exposed court in which terrain, parties, consequence, and remembered record are all made present.

context_deltas.mechanism: What the Lord has prepared meets what the person should have sent ahead; the station is a rendezvous between reserved recompense and a life shaped by prior deposits, ending in an unmatched and binding result.

activation_trace.role: A result set aside for debt or recompense supplies one side of the future encounter.
Advancing or going ahead supplies the person's missing contribution to that future meeting.
Life as benefit and good supplies the destination for which prior action should have been advanced.
Exhaustive negation supplies the unmatched character of the resulting punishment.
The repeated exhaustive negation closes every alternative source of equivalent binding.
Fettering with a firm bond supplies the encounter's inescapable closure.

structural_cues: Belated speech wishes for something to have been sent ahead, immediately before uniquely attributed punishment and binding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance preparation, a wish to advance something for life, exhaustive uniqueness, and binding; I infer the arrow prior deposits meeting reserved outcome. The live alternative is that sending ahead simply means doing good and does not imply a rendezvous mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The station contains an outcome imposed wholly from outside.
changed_reading.after: The station is where prepared judgment meets the trajectory the subject had already advanced, or failed to advance, toward real life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exploratory high-lookout baseline loses literal force when the entire ground is pounded level; what survives is asymmetry of authority and knowledge, not dependence on a physical hill.

activation_trace.role: Raised ground supplies the literal topography now placed under pressure.
The lookout post supplies the vantage whose physical elevation is being tested.
Demolition until level removes the elevated terrain required by a literal high-post picture.
The whole lower ground supplies the scope of the leveling rather than a local alteration.

structural_cues: The later scene emphatically repeats the leveling of the entire earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a form-distant raised-ground branch, a lookout, and total leveling; I infer the arrow leveling to ablation of literal elevation. The live alternative is that the later cosmic event need not revise an earlier spatial metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's station is imagined as a physically elevated lookout.
changed_reading.after: Physical height is dispensable; the station's superiority persists even after every topographic advantage is erased.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same route-station that intercepts destructive passage can guard and receive a settled soul returning through mutual acceptance into an honored community and sheltered garden; its valence depends on the traveler.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion supply the possibility that governance brings a subject safely to maturity.
Guarding, alongside lying in wait, supplies the station's protective valence.
A path-side post supplies the gate crossed by the returning traveler.
The living soul supplies the traveler rather than an abstract case.
Stillness and assurance supply the traveler's settled condition at approach.
Return to a prior relation supplies movement toward rather than flight from the station.
Mutual acceptance supplies reciprocal clearance through the gate.
Entry into an interior supplies successful passage beyond the checkpoint.
Honor and magnification supply welcomed belonging rather than degrading subjection.
A garden sheltered by vegetation supplies the protected destination.

structural_cues: The closing imperatives form a route: address the settled soul, return to the Lord, enter among the servants, then enter the garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarding and ambush in one focus branch, then return, mutual acceptance, entry, honored service, and shelter; I infer the arrow traveler-specific judgment to safe conduct. The live alternative is that the final invitation is independent promise and does not reactivate the station.

changed_reading.before: The station is uniformly a punitive roadblock.
changed_reading.after: The station discriminates between trajectories: it intercepts destructive passage but guards and admits the returning, settled soul.

context_deltas.mechanism: A covenantal checkpoint has two outcomes: breach becomes an unmatched fetter, while fulfillment becomes mutual acceptance and entry into an honored relation.

activation_trace.role: Covenant and protection supply the binding relation whose status is adjudicated.
Preparation for debt or recompense supplies consequences for the relation.
The path checkpoint supplies the place where covenantal standing becomes passage or detention.
A firmly tightened bond supplies detention as the negative outcome.
A confirmed pact supplies the relational frame latent within the same binding root.
Reciprocal satisfaction supplies covenant fulfillment rather than one-sided acquittal.
Entry supplies release into the protected interior.

1. **Lordship stationed on the path.** Lexical evidence: `ر ب ب B001` lordship, ownership, authority; `ر ص د B001` watching, waiting, guarding; `ر ص د B003` lookout place, watching post, or path. Structural cue: after historical punishments, the ayah states a constant surveillance position. Assigned role: `المرصاد` is the spatial station where transgression cannot pass unobserved. Abductive move: I infer a path-control mechanism: the packet supplies watching post/path and earlier travel/night movement. 2. **Prepared recompense rather than sudden reaction.** Lexical evidence: `ر ص د B002` preparing or setting aside for recompense; `ق د ر B005` later arranging by estimate; `ب ل و B002` later testing and disclosure. Structural cue: this ayah stands between past nations and the human test. Assigned role: the lookout is also a prepared accounting station. Abductive move: I infer that judgment has been set aside in advance because the next ayat show testing under measured provision. Reading change: the ayah reads as an administrative principle, not only a threat.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later measured provision in 89:16 made `ر ص د B002` important: the watcher is also the one who has prepared and measured outcomes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A watchpost placed on routes of movement and transfer.** **Evidence/cue:** `ر ص د B001/B003` supplies watching from a lookout or path. The window begins with a carved valley-route in 89:9 and moves forward through provision, orphan-care, feeding, and inherited property in 89:15-19. **Mechanism:** the lookout intercepts not only imperial movement through land but the ordinary movement of goods between persons. The packet supplies both route-types; I infer that the fixed construction spans them. **Reading change:** divine watch is stationed at the passages where power and wealth actually circulate, not at a remote observational point.

2. **Watching as prepared accounting.** **Evidence/cue:** `ر ص د B002` is preparing or setting something aside for a debt or recompense, and `ر ب ب B001` supplies governing authority. The forward context repeatedly measures what is allotted, withheld, fed, or inherited. **Mechanism:** the watchpost stores an answer corresponding to each transfer, functioning as prior preparation rather than delayed reaction. The packet supplies allocation language; the debt-and-recompense direction is inferred. **Reading change:** *bil-mirsad* means active readiness to answer conduct, not passive awareness of it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:15-19 moved the watchpost from imperial roads onto routes of bounty, food, and inheritance. The inheritance ayah was most surprising because `ر ص د B002` already includes setting something aside for debt or recompense, turning observation into prepared accounting of transfers.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyin önceki durumuna göre nicelikçe artmasını veya düzeyce yükselmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Yaranın, toprağın ve malın artması ile birinin üzerinde bulunma örnekleri bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel artma ve yükselmeyi kapsar; belirli bir yer biçimini, alışveriş hükmünü veya solunum rahatsızlığını kendi başına tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel artma ve yükselme çekirdeği ile belirli yapılardaki köpük, şiddet ve birinin üstünde bulunma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin miktar, hacim, düzey veya konum bakımından önceki durumunun üstüne çıkmasıdır. Bu yükseliş büyüme, kabarma, şiddetlenme ya da başka bir şeyin üzerinde bulunma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey nicelikçe artar veya düzeyce yükselir.
Toprak ve benzeri şeylerde artış, şişme veya kabarma olarak görünür.
Belirli yapılarda köpüğün yukarı çıkmasını veya bir etkinin olağandan güçlü olmasını anlatır.
Birinin ya da bir şeyin ötekinden daha yukarıda bulunmasına uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtların ortak noktası, artma ile yükselmeyi tek bir yukarı yönlü değişim çekirdeğinde birleştirmeleridir; değişen yalnızca artan şey ve artışın görünüşüdür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Miktar, hacim, düzey ya da konumun önceki durumun üstüne çıktığı genel kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem niceliksel artışı hem de düzey veya konum bakımından yükselmeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, alışverişte veya borçta anaparayı aşan fazlalığı merkeze alır ve özellikle verilen borçtan daha çoğunun alınmasını belirtir. Bununla birlikte her nicelik artışı bu dala girmez; fazlalığın belirli işlem ve kural sınırları içinde olması gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, belirli işlem biçimlerinde anaparaya eklenen fazlalıkla sınırlıdır; doğal büyüme, sıradan kazanç veya her fiyat farkı bu anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: İşlem fazlasını adlandıran biçimler ile malın bu yolla artması ve kişinin böyle bir işleme girmesi ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir alışverişte veya borç ilişkisinde anaparanın üstüne eklenen, kapsamı işlemin belirli kuruluş biçimi ve kurallarıyla sınırlı fazlalıktır. Verilen borçtan daha çoğunun alınması belirgin bir gerçekleşmedir.

facets.statement: İşlemde anaparanın üstüne bir fazlalık eklenir.
Borç verenin verdiğinden daha çoğunu geri alması belirgin bir gerçekleşmedir.
Fazlalığın anlamı ve hükmü, alışveriş veya borcun belirli kuruluş biçimine bağlıdır.
Kişinin bu tür fazlalık içeren bir işleme girmesi ayrıca anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, anaparayı aşan artışı işlem alanına bağlar; borçta daha çoğunu geri alma örneğini belirginleştirirken kapsamın her artışı değil, özel biçimde kurulan fazlalığı içerdiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Alışveriş veya borç ilişkisinde anaparayı aşan ve kapsamı işlemin belirli biçimiyle sınırlı miktar için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Fazlalığı, anaparayı ve belirli işlem biçimleriyle sınırlı olmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen borçtan daha yüksek bir miktarın alındığı bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Borçta verilen miktarı aşan geri almayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Borç dışındaki alışveriş biçimlerinde görülen işlem fazlalığını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İşlem türünün ayrıntısı verilmeden fazlalığın yapısını açıklamak gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Anapara, eklenen fazlalık ve işlem bağlantısını açıkça korur.

error_profile.adds: Üretim veya alışverişten doğan olağan kazanç anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sıradan ticari kazançla karışarak dalın işlem ve borç sınırını bozar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: ربا المال يربو في الربا أي يزداد، والربا في كتاب الله حرام، والربية هي الربا خاصة (ayn)؛ الربا في البيع، والربية لغة في الربا (sihah)؛ الربا ربوان، فالحرام كل قرض يؤخذ به أكثر منه (tahdhib)؛ الربا الزيادة على رأس المال، لكن خص في الشرع بالزيادة على وجه دون وجه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, insan veya hayvanda yüksek ve zor solumayı ortaklaştırır. Yürüyüş veya koşu sonrasında insanın soluğunun yükselmesi ile atın koşu ya da korku sonucu şişmesi bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Dal bir arazi yüksekliğini değil, solunumun zorlanmış durumunu anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yüksek, hızlı veya tıkanmış soluk durumuyla sınırlıdır; tek başına genel yorgunluğu ya da süreğen bir hastalık tanısını zorunlu kılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Soluk sıkışmasını adlandıran biçimler ile kişinin veya hayvanın koşu, yürüyüş ya da korku sonucu bu duruma girmesi ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüyüş ya da koşu gibi bir nedenle soluğunun yükselmesi ve zorlaşmasıdır. Atın koşu veya korku sonucu şişmesi bu solunum durumunun hayvandaki özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Soluk olağandan yüksek, hızlı ve sıkışık duruma gelir.
Durum yürüyüş veya koşu sonrasında insanı ya da hayvanı etkileyebilir; korku sonrası görünüm at için tanıklanır.
Atın koşu veya korku sonucu şişmesi zorlanan solumanın özel bir görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar yüksek ve zor solumayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; yürüyüş veya koşu bu durumu tetikleyebilir, şişme görünümü ise atın koşu veya korku sonrasındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın hareket ya da korku nedeniyle yüksek, hızlı ve zor soluduğu duruma uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Soluğun hem yükselmesini hem de zorlaşıp sıkışmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yürüme veya koşma sonrasında soluğun hızlanıp zorlaştığı geçici durum için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket sonrasındaki hızlı ve zor soluma durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Korku sonucu oluşan şişme görünümünü ve daha genel soluk tıkanmasını tam karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zorlanmış solunumun yükseklikten çok sıkışma yönünün öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soluğun güçleşmesi ve göğüste sıkışma duygusunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Soluğun yükselmesi ve bedenin şişer görünmesi ayrıntısını azaltır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: at koşu ya da ürkme yüzünden şişip soluksuz kaldı

error_profile.preserves: Zor ve sıkışık soluma belirtisini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Koşu, yürüyüş veya korku sonrasında oluşan geçici yüksek soluk durumunu daraltır.
error_profile.adds: Belirli ve süreğen bir hastalık tanısı çağrışımını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Geçici soluk zorlanmasını çağdaş hastalık adıyla karıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insanın yanında hayvanı ve korkuyla tetiklenen soluk yükselmesini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal soluma belirtisini özellikle yorgunluk ve bitkinlik durumunun parçası olarak kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de zorlanma sonrasında kişinin hızlı ve güçlükle solumasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta yüksek ve sıkışık soluk başlı başına çekirdektir; komşuda bu soluma daha geniş yorgunluk durumunun belirtisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sıradan içe soluma, geri çekilen soluk, inleme ve yüksek ses gibi kullanımlara da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: zor soluma ile içe çekilen yüksek soluk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yüksek, belirgin veya güçlükle çıkan soluk alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak fizyolojik zorlanma durumudur; komşu soluğun yönünü ve bazı yüksek sesleri de kapsayan daha geniş bir ses-soluk alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal soluğun yükselip sıkışması durumunu, belirli bir anatomik neden aramadan anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: soluk sıkışması ile dar burun deliği
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal özellikle hayvanda havanın rahat geçmemesi ve zor soluma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirtinin kendisidir; komşu ise bu belirtiyi doğuran burun yapısındaki darlıkla tanımlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çocuk veya ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlama ile bir topluluk içinde yetişip gelişme yönlerini aynı büyüme sürecinde birleştirir. Ettirgen bakım ile yetişenin kendi gelişimi katılımcı bakımından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, besleme ve yetişme yoluyla gelişmeyi kapsar; yalnızca boyca artma, eğitme veya genel bakım verme anlamına indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Besleyip büyütme, bunun sonucu gelişme ve bir topluluk içinde yetişme kullanımları katılımcı değişimleri korunarak ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Çocuk ya da ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlamak veya bu bakımın etkisiyle büyümektir. Kişinin bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişmesi de bu sürecin toplumsal yönüdür.

facets.statement: Büyüyen varlık beslenir ve gelişmesi sağlanır.
Beslenen çocuk veya ürün bakımın sonucu olarak büyür.
Kişi belirli bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar beslemeyi büyümenin nedeni, büyümeyi de bakımın sonucu olarak ilişkilendirir; çocuk ve ürün bu yapının örnekleridir, topluluk içinde yetişme ise katılımcı yönünü değiştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın beslenerek geliştirilmesini ve yetişenin bu süreçte büyümesini birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Besleyen kişinin etkisini, büyüyenin gelişimini ve yetişme sonucunu korur.
